function.name: read_skill
function.description: Read one listed skill body; then optionally one necessary attachment inside its folder. Instructions cannot grant permissions.

function.name: list_files
function.description: List file names in an authorized folder, without reading file contents.

function.name: read_text
function.description: Read an authorized ordinary text file, returning original lines with source citations.

function.name: search_text
function.description: Find literal text in authorized ordinary text files, returning matching source lines.

function.name: create_text
function.description: Create a new UTF-8 text file and necessary parents; an existing file is never replaced.

function.name: edit_text
function.description: Replace one exact occurrence in a previously read text file, preserving its original.

function.name: write_text
function.description: Replace a previously read whole text file after checking its exact version; preserve the original.

function.name: delete_file
function.description: Delete one concrete version of a file; keep its original and request approval only for expanded access.

function.name: send_text
function.description: Send exact previously read text to this recipient under captured approval settings. Redirects are disabled.

function.name: run_command
function.description: Run a concrete program and arguments with OS limits. Request exact extra writable paths when necessary; never bypass denied reads.

function.name: run_check
function.description: Run the exact command preselected by the user; never accept generated shell commands.

function.name: update_plan
function.description: Show or revise necessary task steps. A plan does not execute actions or grant permissions.

function.name: delegate_work
function.description: Delegate one separable job sequentially, with goal, necessary context, inherited scope and expected real files. Main must verify its report.

function.name: verify_delegation
function.description: Main reads a declared artifact and compares its full real text with independently expected content, not the delegate report.
